author: physics_review
approval_basis: Root accepted the A/B/C/D scope proposal on 2026-10-10. This is an engineering release qualification of prescribed mathematical cases; no user-specific SLA or experimental prediction accuracy was supplied or approved.
temporal_scope: Existing outcomes are known and explicitly reused. Consolidating their criteria is not a retrospective preregistration. The B01/B02/B03 repeat recipe and unchanged criteria are fixed before new repeat observations; the same previously observed seed is a version reproducibility check, not a fresh unseen cohort.

acceptance_contract.coordinate_scope: Cartesian XY and two-degree-of-freedom RZ meridional; no azimuthal state or three-dimensional radial Brownian law.
general_conditions: Only the prescribed equations, initial states, fields, walls and listed resolutions are qualified. A smaller h, greater depth, rescaled geometry or additional force does not acquire qualification by implication.
Mass is the explicit canonical inertia authority. Drag diameter, electrostatic radius and contact radius are distinct inputs.

Complete expected particle population, finite accepted state, zero safety failures in qualified physical runs, and result/input/revision identity are required. Accuracy qualification and safe failure remain separate.

Manufactured uniform, affine or time-linear fields are exactly represented by their prescribed field layout. This does not validate a measured or COMSOL-generated background field, its mesh/time resolution, source distribution or material adhesion law.
Existing output/tile/resume invariance and boundary response tests are release regression evidence, not an independent physical validation of wall parameters.

profiles.producer_obligations: Single/effective Maxwellian closure, mean-free-path definition, collisionless unmagnetized absorbing OML sphere assumptions, screening/ion distributions, heat-flux meaning and reconstructed vorticity are producer premises. Numeric gates do not establish them experimentally.
profiles.nonclaims: Barnes3/4, aggregatepi/4 and pseudogas gap are verified model-form differences, not corrected numerical bugs or a certified downstream deposition error budget. Rarefied lift and effective-gas heat flux remain explicit sensitivity models.

acceptance_contract.B_statistical_interpretation: The inherited seven-standard-error Gaussian/Wishart criteria and fixed finite-resolution allowances are engineering stochastic regression criteria. They are not a newly claimed exact joint family-confidence bound, certified weak/strong convergence order, or application-level prediction tolerance.

C_common_inputs.reference_interpretation: Kramers measured refinement allowance is operational, not a rigorous PDE-error upper bound. Conditional finite-depth Hermite path first-hit is compared to continuous references within the listed probability budgets.

original_Brownian_requirement.meaning: Confidence criterion not met; not proof that true discretization bias exceeds .03. D4 post-observation qualification and separately preregistered held-out D2 PASS remain distinct.

unmeasured_physical_predictions: Experimentally validated chamber deposition or contamination KPI
Measured particle source populations and release distributions
Material sticking/restitution/re-emission probabilities and calibrated adhesion parameters
Original background-field fidelity and all unseen dynamics between supplied field snapshots
Model-form uncertainty propagation into an unspecified downstream product KPI
not_claimed: Exact continuous OU first passage or zero-miss probability
General SDE strong/weak order for arbitrary time/state-dependent coefficients and charge
Three-dimensional or general cylindrical radial Brownian law
All model/geometry/wall combinations or all h/depth values
User-specific accuracy, latency, throughput or RSS SLA
acceptance_contract.C_reference_observable_scope: Arrival CDF accuracy is evaluated at the five listed times; repeated-specular position and joint CDF accuracy is evaluated at the eleven registered probes at final time. MC simultaneous bands do not promote unmeasured reference values to a whole-time or whole-state accuracy claim.

D_numeric_applicability.Stokes_Cunningham_Allen_Raabe: radius Kn in [.03,7.2], particle Re<=.1; producer mean-free-path convention
D_numeric_applicability.stationary_OML: a/lambda_D<=.1, declared stationary drift ratio<=.1 and per-step h*L_Z<=.5; collisionless/unmagnetized/isolated absorbing equipotential sphere is a producer premise
D_numeric_applicability.Saffman: D01 numeric hierarchy, unbounded creeping shear premise; near-wall applicability not established
D_numeric_applicability.Barnes: Z<=0; a/lambda_D,b90/lambda_D,bc/lambda_D<=.1; ion-neutral mean-free-path/lambda_D>=10; positive Coulomb log and declared drift envelope
D_numeric_applicability.Waldmann: lambda/a>=10, slip/cbar<=.1; q means translational gas heat flux; Fourier form lambda*abs(gradT)/T<=.01
D_numeric_applicability.Talbot: Original radius-Kn binding and positive primitives/coefficient inputs; no arbitrary production Kn cutoff is claimed to establish experimental validity
D_numeric_applicability.effective_gas_and_rarefied_lift: Explicit sensitivity revisions and producer closure/coefficient premises; no generic physical validation certificate
